body:
The campaign did not establish a new enabling scientific capability. This intake preserves the selected chemical-quantitation HOLD, decisive failed mechanisms, actual-data audits, a corrected matched molecular benchmark, and restricted mathematical theorems with exact internal verification.

Start at `updates/enabling-capability-20261015/READ_ME_FIRST.txt` and `evidence/root/REPORT.txt`. The mathematical results cover Schmidt-rank-two references in arbitrary ambient dimensions and full uniform references in equal dimensions; unrestricted Werner problems and novelty remain open. The chemical route requires independent structural quantitation on the same samples before further deep invention.

The packet records 30 workers (16 Sol max, 14 Astra max), substantive contribution provenance, actual telemetry, source receipts, failures and append-only corrections. It includes a unique live receive-only IQ observation, without claiming calibrated propagation inference. Large raw archives, runtime dependencies and publisher material are excluded with acquisition pointers; not every script is self-contained in a fresh checkout.

Validation: exact rank-two symbolic replay, independent sharp uniform spectral audit, chemical decision arithmetic, curated hashes, frontier freshness and technology validation. Historical checkpoint validation remains blocked by unsupported checkpoint schemas. No existing scientific card or experimental status is promoted. Publication and internal review are not physical validation or novelty clearance.

Full-patch whitespace checking flags original CRLF license files and the original live-acquisition log. Their bytes are deliberately preserved; all other files pass the scoped check. Exact exceptions and original output are in `WHITESPACE_RECEIPT_v0001.json`.
